mapper.select: SELECT auto_saving_id AS autoSavingId, user_id AS userId, money_box_id AS moneyBoxId, account_id AS accountId, max_amount AS maxAmount, auto_saving_status AS autoSavingStatus FROM auto_saving WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT a.auto_saving_id, a.auto_saving_status AS status, a.max_amount, m.money_box_id, m.balance, m.masked_account_number, CASE WHEN h.auto_saving_history_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS todaySaved, h.amount AS todaySavingAmount FROM auto_saving a INNER JOIN money_box m ON a.money_box_id = m.money_box_id LEFT JOIN auto_saving_history h ON a.auto_saving_id = h.auto_saving_id AND h.transacted_at = CURDATE() WHERE a.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auto_saving_history WHERE auto_saving_id = #{autoSavingId} AND transacted_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND transacted_at < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(CURDATE()), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT CASE week_days.day_index WHEN 0 THEN 'MONDAY' WHEN 1 THEN 'TUESDAY' WHEN 2 THEN 'WEDNESDAY' WHEN 3 THEN 'THURSDAY' WHEN 4 THEN 'FRIDAY' WHEN 5 THEN 'SATURDAY' WHEN 6 THEN 'SUNDAY' END AS dayOfWeek, CASE WHEN h.auto_saving_history_id IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS saved, h.amount FROM (SELECT 0 AS day_index UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6) week_days LEFT JOIN auto_saving_history h ON h.auto_saving_id = #{autoSavingId} AND h.transacted_at = DATE_ADD( DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL week_days.day_index DAY ) ORDER BY week_days.day_index
SELECT transacted_at FROM auto_saving_history WHERE auto_saving_id = #{autoSavingId} AND transacted_at <= CURDATE() ORDER BY transacted_at DESC LIMIT 60
